display.purpose: Compact uppercase app titles, panel summaries, and dialog heads.

title.purpose: High-emphasis button, tab, chip, and control titles.

body.purpose: Default UI text and concise explanatory fragments.

label.purpose: Small structural labels, matrix headers, timeline lanes, and status tags.

mono.purpose: MIDI/debug tables and code-like timing data only.

shadows.name: panel-inset
shadows.purpose: Subtle top edge on major panels.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Checkbox, hover, and compact state transitions.

motion.name: product-state
motion.purpose: Product UI state changes only, no decorative choreography.

breakpoints.name: small-screen

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one local commit or materialize action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 28px; padding: 5px 10px; color: var(--accent-ink, #211309); background: var(--accent, #e0a45f); border: 1px solid #e0c269; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 3px); font: 800 0.86rem var(--font-ui, Avenir Next, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #dfbd59; border-color: #ead07a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ui-accent-line, rgba(224, 164, 95, 0.54)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ordinary command button for dense panels.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 28px; padding: 5px 10px; color: var(--text, #f1ece7); background: var(--surface-2, #27212f); border: 1px solid var(--line, #4b4055); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 3px); font: 800 0.86rem var(--font-ui, Avenir Next, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-3, #332a3d); border-color: var(--line-strong, #74617d); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ui-accent-line, rgba(224, 164, 95, 0.54)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Recessed Input
components.description: Dark recessed field for exact musical values.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: var(--muted, #c9bdc7); font: 800 0.72rem var(--font-ui, Avenir Next, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-input { min-height: 28px; width: 104px; padding: 5px 7px; color: var(--text, #f1ece7); background: var(--surface-0, #111018); border: 1px solid var(--line, #4b4055); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 3px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28); font: 650 0.86rem var(--font-ui, Avenir Next, sans-serif); text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ui-accent-line, rgba(224, 164, 95, 0.54)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Compact binary feature state with amber selected cue.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--text, #f1ece7); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #e0a45f) 16%, var(--surface-2, #27212f)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #e0a45f) 46%, var(--line, #4b4055)); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 3px); font: 800 0.78rem var(--font-ui, Avenir Next, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-toggle span { width: 9px; height: 9px; background: var(--accent, #e0a45f); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-toggle:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #e0a45f) 22%, var(--surface-2, #27212f)); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ui-accent-line, rgba(224, 164, 95, 0.54)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel Surface
components.css: .ds-panel { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 260px; padding: 8px; color: var(--text, #f1ece7); background: var(--panel, #211d27); border: 1px solid var(--line, #4b4055); border-radius: var(--radius, 4px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035); } .ds-panel strong { color: var(--accent, #e0a45f); font: 700 0.82rem var(--font-display, DIN Alternate, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #c9bdc7); font: 500 0.78rem var(--font-ui, Avenir Next, sans-serif); }

components.name: Timeline Track
components.html: RATCHET
components.css: .ds-timeline { position: relative; width: 360px; height: 32px; background: var(--surface-1, #1c1722); border: 1px solid var(--line, #4b4055); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 3px); overflow: hidden; } .ds-lane-label { position: absolute; left: 6px; top: 5px; z-index: 1; padding: 1px 5px; color: var(--muted, #c9bdc7); background: var(--surface-0, #111018); border: 1px solid var(--line, #4b4055); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 3px); font: 800 0.66rem var(--font-ui, Avenir Next, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-timeline i { position: absolute; top: 15px; height: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #e0a45f) 16%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #e0a45f) 62%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 3px); }

components.name: Ratchet Event Marker
components.description: Ratchet event bar with visible internal hit marks.
components.css: .ds-ratchet { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-around; width: 160px; height: 14px; padding: 0 4px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #e0a45f) 16%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #e0a45f) 62%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 3px); } .ds-ratchet b { width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--accent, #e0a45f); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 245, 214, 0.34); border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Matrix Heat Cell
components.description: Probability cell with canonical heat ramp behavior.
components.css: .ds-heat-cell { display: grid; gap: 3px; place-items: center; width: 54px; padding: 5px; color: #111018; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(241 200 122 / 0.86), rgb(155 99 39 / 0.68)), #111; border: 1px solid rgba(240, 193, 124, 0.48); box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(224, 164, 95, 0.2); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 3px); } .ds-heat-cell span { font: 800 0.7rem var(--font-ui, Avenir Next, sans-serif); } .ds-heat-cell input { width: 36px; min-height: 22px; color: var(--text, #f1ece7); background: var(--surface-1, #1c1722); border: 1px solid var(--line, #4b4055); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 3px); text-align: center; font: 700 0.75rem var(--font-ui, Avenir Next, sans-serif); }

components.name: Active Tab
components.css: .ds-tab { min-height: 46px; padding: 6px 10px; color: var(--text, #f1ece7); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #e0a45f) 16%, var(--surface-2, #27212f)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #e0a45f) 46%, var(--line, #4b4055)); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 3px); font: 800 0.72rem var(--font-ui, Avenir Next, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--surface-3, #332a3d); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ui-accent-line, rgba(224, 164, 95, 0.54)); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Caesura is a compact musical workbench for dense rhythmic decisions. It should feel like a late-night sampler screen built for serious repeated use: plum-black chassis, small equipment labels, hard-edged lanes, and restrained data colors that always mean something.

The system is minimalist, utilitarian, and instrument-like. Visual hierarchy comes from exact geometry, tonal layers, hairline borders, and state color. Decoration is prohibited unless it carries musical information.

It explicitly rejects generic DAW piano rolls, conventional step sequencers, glossy grooveboxes, academic notation editors, marketing dashboards, cute or game-like synth toys, decorative vaporwave aesthetics, and interfaces that make the timeline feel secondary.
keyCharacteristics: Timeline-first, with one shared horizontal musical coordinate frame.
Amber for active editing and commit actions.
Dusty cyan, muted rose, and lavender only as data or feature-role colors.
Small-radius surfaces, recessed controls, stable lane geometry.
Short labels, no ornamental copy, no spectacle.

rules.name: The Color Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Every saturated color must identify state, data category, selected structure, or musical role. Empty space stays neutral.

rules.name: The Amber Voice Rule
rules.body: Amber is the one primary command and editing voice. Do not make every control amber.

rules.name: The Vaporwave Restraint Rule
rules.body: Dusk Console may use plum, amber, dusty cyan, rose, and lavender. It must not become neon, glossy, gradient-heavy, or decorative.

rules.name: The No Hero Type Rule
rules.body: Caesura is an instrument surface. Do not use landing-page display sizes inside the app.

rules.name: The Zero Tracking Rule
rules.body: Letter spacing is `0`. Labels can be uppercase only when they are short and structural.

rules.name: The Mono Is Debug Rule
rules.body: Monospace is forbidden for ordinary controls. It is only for MIDI, timing, byte, or code-like data.

rules.name: The Flat Console Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat. Shadows must be structural, state-driven, or dialog-specific.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Do not use decorative glow around active timeline events, buttons, panels, headings, or cards.

dos: Do keep the first screen as the working instrument surface.
Do reuse Dusk Console tokens for app chrome and feature panels.
Do keep the timeline visually sovereign and geometrically exact.
Do use amber for primary edit focus, selected structures, and commit actions.
Do use dusty cyan, muted rose, and lavender only for routing, tension, pitch, or feature-role data.
Do keep panel and control radii small (`4px` panels, `3px` controls).
Do use horizontal scroll for dense musical surfaces instead of hiding capability.
Do keep copy short: labels like `Tempo`, `Order`, `Fallback`, `Boundary`; commands like `Save`, `Recall`, `Apply`, `Reset`.
Do make enabled state visible with subtle tint plus stronger hairline.
Do preserve one controlling switch per playback feature.
donts: Don't build generic DAW piano rolls.
Don't make Caesura feel like a glossy groovebox.
Don't turn it into an academic notation editor.
Don't make cute or game-like synth toy surfaces.
Don't let panels, cards, or spectacle make the timeline feel secondary.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, bokeh, or decorative orbs.
Don't use purple-blue gradients, neon glow, or ornamental color fields.
Don't use thick colored side-stripe borders.
Don't use large rounded icon tiles above headings.
Don't use monospace as generic technical flavor.
Don't add duplicate switches, seed inputs, or playback controls in summaries.
